Case Study

Slayground — Inclusive Dance-for-Fun Web App

A Django-based platform that empowers users to book classes, access exclusive tutorials and affirmations, and engage with dance in a judgment-free space — designed and delivered end-to-end (UX + full-stack).

Open Live App

Overview

Slayground was created to merge the joy of dance with an empowering digital community. It integrates class management, bookings, and uplifting online content.

Challenge

Most dance websites only list schedules; Slayground needed to build confidence and community through affirmations, tutorials, and user-friendly booking flows.

Outcome

A responsive web application with a vibrant brand identity, streamlined booking system, and a content hub for affirmations and tutorials — encouraging confidence through dance.

1 platform
Bookings + content in one place
Empowerment-first
Confidence + inclusivity built-in
Responsive
Optimized for mobile dancers

Role & Timeline

Role
UX Designer & Full-Stack Engineer (Django backend, booking logic, content hub, responsive UI)
Timeline
~12 weeks (research, design sprints, full-stack build)
Tools
Django 5.2, Python 3.13, Bootstrap 5, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, SQLite/PostgreSQL, Figma

Personas

Sophia — Beginner Dancer

Bio: 24-year-old marketing assistant who wants to build confidence and find a supportive community outside of work.

Goals: Try beginner-friendly dance classes, gain confidence in movement, and connect with other women in a fun environment.

Pain: Feels intimidated by traditional studios and struggles to keep track of class times.

Fit: Uses Slayground to browse beginner classes, book easily from her phone, and access daily affirmations for motivation.

Jordan — Dance Instructor

Bio: 31-year-old professional choreographer who teaches part-time and wants to expand reach to new dancers.

Goals: Fill classes with new students, manage bookings without admin stress, and share empowering content with her community.

Pain: Wastes time managing sign-ups manually through DMs and group chats; no central system for student communication.

Fit: Relies on Slayground’s admin dashboard to manage class capacity, track bookings, and upload motivational content for students.

Style Guide

Bold, expressive UI with strong contrasts to reflect Slayground’s brand: vibrant magenta and pink accents balanced by deep black and gray backgrounds. Accessibility and legibility prioritized for dancers on mobile devices.

Type: Inter and Poppins for UI and body text; bold weights for headings, light to regular weights for body copy.

Process

1. Research & Discovery

  • Surveyed dancers to identify barriers to joining classes.
  • Mapped competitor apps (MindBody, ClassPass) and found gaps in confidence-building content.
  • Defined goals: inclusivity, easy booking, and daily affirmations.

2. Define

  • Personas: Beginner dancer, returning dancer, instructor.
  • Core journeys: browsing → booking → content engagement.

3. Ideate & Wireframe

  • Low-fi prototypes for booking and content hub.
  • Explored magenta/black palette to reinforce bold identity.

4. Prototype

  • Integrated YouTube embeds for dance tutorials + custom affirmation cards.
  • Booking form tied to class model with instructor + spots left.

5. Test & Iterate

  • Validated flows with beta testers (students + instructors).
  • Simplified filters on class list page.

Final Design

  • Homepage Hero: Bold, empowering visuals with tagline.
  • Class Pages: Browse and filter by level, instructor, and date.
  • Booking System: Simple, mobile-friendly booking flows.
  • Content Hub: Affirmations, tutorials, and video embeds.
  • Calendar: Visual weekly/monthly view of upcoming classes.
Wireframes – High-Fidelity Prototypes

Engineering

Slayground is built with Django and Bootstrap, leveraging Django’s ORM for data management and a responsive UI for accessibility. 

Stack:
- Backend: Django 5.2, Python 3.13
- Frontend: Bootstrap 5, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript
- Database: SQLite (dev), PostgreSQL (prod)
- Features: booking system, content hub, calendar integration

Key Learnings

  • How to design inclusive branding without losing clarity.
  • Structuring Django models for recurring events and bookings.
  • Embedding media securely for tutorials and affirmations.

Impact

Slayground extends beyond dance scheduling — it delivers a safe, empowering digital home for dancers. It reduces booking friction, boosts confidence, and creates a stronger sense of community.

What’s Next

  • Stripe integration for online payments.
  • Gamified streaks for daily affirmations.
  • Expanded video library with user-submitted tutorials.
